--CRM fcbscif patch
update dw.dimcustomer set fcbscif = customerid where SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' and fcbscif is NULL
--checking
select count(1) from dw.dimcustomer  where SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' and fcbscif is NULL 


--CCD fcbscif patch
update tgt 
set fcbscif = CASE WHEN RC.RelatedCustomerID = '' THEN NULL ELSE RC.RelatedCustomerID END  
from dw.dimcustomer tgt  
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RelatedCustomer RC ON tgt.CustomerId = RC.CustomerId
where tgt.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' and tgt.fcbscif is NULL
--checking
select count(1) from dw.dimcustomer  where SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' and fcbscif is NULL
